model_chinese_name: Mamba密度自适应社会交互残差模型
backbone: frozen EMT-fixed checkpoint from training_regime_diagnostic for same fold and seed
shared_initialization_baseline: emt_sr initialization from same training_regime_diagnostic fold and seed
density_inputs_only: neighbor_mask count divided by fixed limit 8
float32_bound_guard: clamp only floating-point saturation to the nearest strict interior values; algebraic scale remains 1+0.5*tanh(f_d(d))
final_layer_initialization: zero weight and zero bias; initial scale exactly one
calibration_target: multiply Social Cross-Attention context before unchanged residual decoder
split_policy: exact training_regime_diagnostic pedestrian split and source train/validation arrays
comparison_baseline: frozen emt_sr results/checkpoints from training_regime_diagnostic; no baseline retraining
primary_aggregation: scene equal; average per-scene validation metrics within fold/seed, then equal fold/seed weights; pooled sample aggregation reported secondarily

decision_thresholds.go: scene-equal ADE delta <= 0; relative FDE degradation < 0.005; at least one of scene gain population SD, scene gain range, or neighbor-count gain population SD improves >=10%; paired scene-equal ADE wins >=9/15
decision_thresholds.strong_go: GO and scene-equal ADE improves >=1%; scene gain population SD improves >=15%; paired scene-equal ADE wins >=11/15
decision_thresholds.stop: scene-equal ADE relative degradation >0.005 OR paired scene-equal ADE wins <=6/15

density_response_classification_rule: COLLAPSED when Var_n(E[s|n])<1e-6, range<0.01, and every mean scale is within 0.01 of 1; NEAR-GLOBAL when Var<1e-6 and range<0.01 but it is not collapsed; otherwise MEANINGFUL
cross_scene_stability_classification_rul: IMPROVED when both scene gain population SD and range improve at least 5%; WORSE when both worsen at least 5%; otherwise SIMILAR
